weather_report:
This afternoon in Boston, the sun graces the city with warmth and clarity, inviting residents to embrace the gentle touch of a light breeze from the east. With temperatures rising close to a comfortable 76 degrees, the day unfolds with a steadfast brightness that drowns out the remnants of any lingering morning fog. As the sun casts its golden glow over the familiar skyline, you'll find the air crisp and invigorating, an ideal setting for leisurely strolls along the Charles or perhaps a quiet moment on a sunlit bench, absorbing the city’s ebb and flow.

As twilight nears, the sky will remain mostly clear, settling down to a soothing low of around 56. A subtle north wind may whisper softly, carrying the faint scent of summer evenings. It’s a perfect night to don light layers that can ward off the coolness once the sun takes its leave. Consider curling up with a well-loved book on a patio or savoring a casual dinner outdoors, letting the gentle warmth of the day fade into a tranquil evening. The conditions, with their inviting charm, promise a delightful experience, whether you explore the local art scene or simply enjoy a gathering with friends under the stars, enveloped in the serene pulse of the city.
